metadata.name: rtd-ab
metadata.description: Analysis-only ARTF RTBExtensionPoint A/B test example for content-signal enrichment. Each PUBLISHER_BID_REQUEST auction is routed by the last hex digit of its auction id (bid_request.id before the first underscore): digits below the test-group count go to a test arm, the rest to control. The mix and each arm's enabled signal sources and allowlists are read at startup from ab-config.json and the model directories it names under MODEL_PATH (model_data/); without them the container uses built-in models at the percentage baked at build time (image label rtd.ab.test_pct). The share is aligned to the nearest 1/16. Both arms return zero mutations on every request and record how many content signals they could derive as rtd_ab_* metrics. Logs only startup lines, errors and at most one summary line per arm per minute.

metrics.description: Standard Prometheus metrics, including the required rpc_server_duration histogram with seconds buckets and the rtd_ab_* experiment metrics.

definitions.name: rpc_server_duration
definitions.description: Required Index metric: inbound RPC handler duration, seconds buckets (0.001 to 0.010).

definitions.name: rtd_simple_response_seconds_avg
definitions.description: Average GetMutations handler duration in seconds (convenience; percentiles come from rpc_server_duration).

definitions.name: rtd_simple_cpu_seconds_total
definitions.description: Cumulative container CPU time in seconds, read from the cgroup.

definitions.name: rtd_simple_cpu_limit_cores
definitions.description: CPU allocation in cores (denominator for CPU percent).

definitions.name: rtd_simple_memory_bytes
definitions.description: Current container memory usage in bytes, read from the cgroup.

definitions.name: rtd_simple_memory_limit_bytes
definitions.description: Memory allocation in bytes (denominator for memory percent).

definitions.name: rtd_simple_memory_percent
definitions.description: Container memory usage as a percent of its limit (0 to 100).

definitions.name: rtd_simple_build_info
definitions.description: Build/version info; model_version reflects the delivered model manifest, if any.

definitions.name: rtd_simple_model_present
definitions.description: 1 if a model manifest was found at MODEL_PATH at startup, 0 otherwise. Presence only; the container does not read the model data.

definitions.name: rtd_simple_ready
definitions.description: 1 when the container is ready to serve traffic, 0 otherwise.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_test_pct
definitions.description: Effective share of auctions routed to the test arm, in percent (baked at build time, a multiple of 6.25).

definitions.name: rtd_ab_build_info
definitions.description: Effective split and strategy names; value is always 1.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_models_info
definitions.description: Model directory per arm and where the models came from (file, builtin_absent, builtin_invalid); value is always 1.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_requests_total
definitions.description: Auctions routed, by arm (control, test). Always present; excludes unrouted requests.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_unrouted_total
definitions.description: Requests not analyzed, by reason (no_id, not_hex, other_lifecycle). Absent until the first one.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_analyze_seconds
definitions.description: Routing plus analysis time per request in seconds, sampled 1 in 16, 1 microsecond to 1 millisecond buckets.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_errors_total
definitions.description: Recovered strategy panics by arm. Absent until the first one.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_content_enrichable_total
definitions.description: Analyzed requests with at least one derivable signal.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_content_signals
definitions.description: Derivable content signals per request (0 to 10).

definitions.name: rtd_ab_content_signals_sumsq
definitions.description: Sum of squared signal counts, for a Welch t-test.

definitions.name: rtd_ab_content_signal_total
definitions.description: Signals by source (category, genre, keyword, network, eid); none counts requests with no signal.

readiness.description: Readiness probe. Per the Index Cloud KB, readiness uses the same grpc.health.v1.Health protocol as liveness, on GRPC_PORT, not a separate HTTP path.

env.name: RTD_AB_SUMMARY_SEC
env.description: Interval in seconds of the per-arm summary log line (at most one line per arm per interval, none for an idle arm); 0 disables.
